concept.title: Types of Two-Factor Identification
concept.shortdesc: A list of common two-factor identification types.

conbody.p:
Working with Qualtrics begins by logging in, typically to a web portal. This step will vary depending upon the home institution. Most universities, for instance, will use a form of two-factor authentication and additional screening from a university-internal domain. Qualtrics easily handles most common two-factor authentication types including:
Duo Mobile
Google Authenticator
SMS-based Authentication
Email Authentication
Logging in to Qualtrics differs enough at each institution that it is outside the scope of a basic user's guide. Follow institution-specific technical guides specific to each use-case.
